new_source_confirmed_gaps.name: Live gun rounds and pairing state
new_source_confirmed_gaps.evidence: src/scripting/instruments.zig Guns has group/groups/all/synchronised/gun/charge/full_charge, no rounds or paired boolean; objects.zig also has no live gun-round field.

new_source_confirmed_gaps.name: Light presentation state
new_source_confirmed_gaps.evidence: lights returns names only. lightsShown uses IconTest.set and treats flashing icons as active, not the visible phase. No device charge in HUD fields; countermeasure readout is only a count.

new_source_confirmed_gaps.name: Window and missile animation state
new_source_confirmed_gaps.evidence: open_windows returns names; missiles returns armed,left,ring. No native window phase/progress or ring interpolation.

new_source_confirmed_gaps.name: Picture mirroring/source rectangles
new_source_confirmed_gaps.evidence: picture size/style support colour and alpha. Mod-side mirrored/cropped exports are a working alternative; convenience rather than a release blocker.
